fact: Labour minister Bentaleb says over 1.9 million jobseekers receive a DA 15,000 monthly unemployment allowance paid into CCP postal accounts, staggered 26-28 of the month by account number.

Algeria's national social insurance fund CNAS and Algerie Poste signed a convention on 26 June 2024 to set up remote processing of benefit transfers to social-insurance beneficiaries' CCP accounts through a secure electronic data-exchange platform.
